requirements.text: The Python calculator must accept a single arithmetic expression as a command-line argument.
requirements.source_quote: Build a Python calculator that accepts one arithmetic expression as a plain text command-line argument and prints its answer as plain text.

requirements.text: The calculator must support addition (+), subtraction (-), multiplication (*), and division (/) operations.
